roles.source: Partner client events and registered decision inputs
roles.target: Durable Filter decisions and bounded partner form projection

transformClassification.evidenceBasis: The profile selects version-controlled directional Spark SQL mappings with fixed graph and form projections; readiness still requires pinned implementation evidence.

schemaShape: edge-only decision output and bounded form table
normalizationRules: client event and reason category normalization
mappingExpressions: versioned decision and form projection SQL
profileInputs: source dataset bindings and scale tier
vocabularySelections: existing Lexicon client-event, rule and decision terms

invariants.description: Every admitted client event produces one traceable decision
Decision output is represented by declared graph edges without invented decision vertices
Client identity joins remain deterministic without exposing client identifiers in evidence
The bounded form projection reconciles with decision counts and reason categories

repositories.purpose: DSA product, Filter and partner form boundaries

discoveryProbes.description: Locate decision, client-event and form projection contracts
Resolve exact enabled directional mappings and digests
Bind active runtime to source and configuration digests

identityRules: Derive stable edge identity from declared normalized endpoint roles and rule revision
Never emit client identifiers into validation evidence
endpointRules: Every decision edge endpoint must resolve to a declared client-event or governed rule vertex
Dangling endpoint count must equal zero

adapters.name: partner-file-intake
adapters.contract: Connect lands partner files; Transform does not call Azure or SFTP

consumers.name: filter-runtime
consumers.contract: Consumes registered facts and produces durable traceable outcomes

consumers.name: partner-form-delivery
consumers.contract: Delivers product-produced form output through the registered external adapter
